Multi-layer choropleth + point Leaflet map, switchable by base layer

Source: R/choropleth_point_map.R
mysterymaps_choropleth_point_map.Rd

Generic builder: several toggleable choropleth base groups (radio buttons), a point overlay with name search, a scale bar, a per-layer legend that swaps with the active base layer, and an optional title card and footnote. Each layer is coloured with mysterymaps_jenks_zero_scale(), so a 0 count always gets its own colour rather than the bottom of a gradient.

Usage

mysterymaps_choropleth_point_map(
  layers,
  points,
  value_col = "n",
  point_fill,
  point_legend = NULL,
  legend_title_fmt = "Count per %s",
  title_html = NULL,
  footnote_html = NULL,
  search_group = "Points",
  search_placeholder = "Search...",
  default_layer = names(layers)[1],
  jenks_k = 6,
  fill_opacity = 0.9,
  point_radius = 6
)

Arguments

layers

Named list of sf polygon layers. Each must carry id, the count column (value_col), a label column (hover HTML) and a popup column (click HTML). The list order sets the radio order; default_layer is shown first.

points

sf point layer with label and popup columns.

value_col

character(1): count column used for colouring each layer. Default "n".

point_fill

character(1): fill colour for the point markers.

point_legend

Optional list(colors=, labels=, title=) for a separate point legend (top-right).

legend_title_fmt

sprintf() template taking the layer name, used as each choropleth legend's title (may contain HTML).

title_html

Optional HTML for a top-left title card.

footnote_html

Optional HTML rendered as a caption (bottom-left).

search_group

character(1): group name for the searchable point layer.

search_placeholder

character(1): placeholder text for the search box.

default_layer

character(1): which layer is shown on load. Default the first name in layers.

jenks_k

integer(1): positive-class count passed to mysterymaps_jenks_zero_scale() for every layer.

fill_opacity

numeric(1): polygon fill alpha. Default 0.90.

point_radius

numeric(1): circle-marker radius in px. Default 6.

Value

A leaflet htmlwidget.

Details

Points render in their own leaflet::addMapPane() above the choropleth (zIndex = 650) so they stay clickable over a dark fill, without the custom-pane hit-testing hazard documented on mysterymaps_physician_dot_map() – that hazard is for a pane with a dedicated canvas renderer; this pane shares the map's default renderer.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
counties <- sf::st_sf(
  id = 1:2, n = c(0, 4), label = c("A", "B"), popup = c("<b>A</b>", "<b>B</b>"),
  geometry = sf::st_sfc(
    sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(-100, -98, -98, -100, -100), c(39, 39, 41, 41, 39)))),
    sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(c(-98, -96, -96, -98, -98), c(39, 39, 41, 41, 39)))),
    crs = 4326))
points <- sf::st_as_sf(
  data.frame(lon = -97, lat = 40, label = "Provider", popup = "<b>Provider</b>"),
  coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
mysterymaps_choropleth_point_map(list(Count = counties), points, point_fill = "#c2185b")
}
